restaurantName: Xiao Dong Men Niu Rou Shui Fen Lao Dian
address: 36-20 & 21 Huangcheng Road, Jiaocheng, Ningde, China Mainland
bio: This well-established, down-to-earth joint specialises in beef rice noodle soup - a staple for many Ningde natives. The broth exudes meaty and herbal aromas that draw in the customers. The slippery rice noodles work magically with pickled mustard greens as well as sliced beef, which retains a lovely chew. Also try their beef offal soup that features cuts like bouncy tripe and tender ox tongue. Beef meatball soup is another best-seller....
pageTitle: Xiao Dong Men Niu Rou Shui Fen Lao Dian
